suppress.notes: False positive: CVE-2025-15104 is an SSRF in the "Nu Html Checker" (vnu) project, misattributed to Hibernate Validator through the shared "validator:validator" CPE (see dependency-check issue #8249). The latest Hibernate Validator is still flagged, confirming the mismatch.

False positive: CVE-2022-31691 affects Spring Boot 2.6.6 and is matched against spring-boot-devtools 4.0.7 via an outdated CPE. Devtools is also excluded from the repackaged boot jar (verified with jar tf).
CVE-2026-66299 is a DoS in the Apache Tomcat WebSocket CHAT EXAMPLE webapp (examples distribution). Embedded Tomcat does not ship the examples app, so the library jars are not affected.
